interfaces.description: Network interface(s) to monitor for ARP changes.

allowed_macs.description: List of MAC addresses allowed to appear on the network (whitelist). Leave empty to disable whitelist.

denied_macs.description: List of MAC addresses that must never appear on the network (blacklist).

action.description: What to do when an unauthorized ARP change is detected. Options: 'log' (only log), 'drop' (block traffic), or 'kill' (terminate process sending malicious ARP).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. 0 = quiet, 1 = normal, 2 = verbose.

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty, logs are sent to syslog.

pid_file.description: Path to PID file for the running daemon.

scan_interval.description: Number of seconds between scans of the system ARP table.

max_delay.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait before reacting to an ARP change. Helps batch rapid changes.

alert_new_ip_mac.description: Alert when an IP gets a new (previously unseen) MAC address.

alert_duplicate_ip.description: Alert when multiple MAC addresses claim the same IP address.

alert_duplicate_mac.description: Alert when the same MAC address appears on multiple IP addresses (often indicates spoofing).

ignore_gateways.description: List of gateway IP addresses whose ARP changes should be ignored (e.g., internal router).

static_bindings.description: List of known, trusted static IP-to-MAC bindings. Prevents false positives.

alert_cmd.description: Command to execute when an alert occurs. Supports %ip% and %mac% placeholders (escape per shell, e.g., %% for literal % in Jinja).

daemonize.description: Run as a background daemon (true) or foreground (false).

run_as_user.description: System user to drop privileges to after starting (only when daemonizing).
